items.title: Ricard Alexis Interview, 1959-01-16
items.q: Shani met me on Rampo in Tulane. He was getting the shoes shined. I got on the stand, I got a shot. They were playing at Millersburg that day. He said, Rick, take a ride out there.

ctx.x: He said he'd entice you to come in the band, Shani, huh?

Shani met me on Rampo in Tulane. He was getting the shoes shined. I got on the stand, I got a shot. They were playing at Millersburg that day. He said, Rick, take a ride out there. Another boy was playing out, and I used to do it. I cooled all out there with her.
Excuse me to interrupt, but how'd you get out there? How'd you get out to Millersburg?
